scientific_conclusion: The stream-A 32-to-64 change is below ten percent, but stream B fails the same frozen criterion. Convergence is not reproducible across donor streams.

The two independent rank64 population estimators differ by as much as 0.306 in natural-log pair ratio, more than three times the frozen tolerance. Increasing to 64 ranks does not define a stable pair objective.

No empirical-rank pair estimator or pair-loss model is selected. Increasing rank count further, choosing a favorable stream, or relaxing the tolerance after seeing this result would be post-hoc tuning.

The remaining scientifically defensible model class must learn query-aligned joint spatial structure through its train-only likelihood or score objective, rather than optimizing a noisy downstream pair statistic.
